title: Rosters: training, the swap rule and days away
question: One round for three things, each sketch shows all three on the phone (the admin panel uses the same pieces, wider): 1) a trainee on a date, 2) the swap rule in How the roster works, 3) the days-away editor, now with repeating days, a time of day and exceptions, which leaders can change for their team. Lock the set closest to what you want; use Steer to mix (e.g. 'B's days away with A's training').

options.label: A: Training as its own line, rules in plain rows
options.thesis: A trainee sits on a line under the position ('Sam, training with Jo'); the place stays open in amber until someone trained is on. Days away split into Regular and Coming up, each rule one sentence.
materials: radio rows with a detail line
options.viewport: Three phones: Sunday 15 Nov's date sheet with Sound 1 of 1 and Sam training with Jo; How the roster works with the swap rule as three radio rows plus 'Ask someone yourself', and a line saying what happens; Days away with Regular ('Sunday mornings, until further notice, except 20 Dec') and Coming up, and its editor sheet.
options.risk: The most rows of the three; the swap preview line adds reading for a setting set once.

options.label: B: Days away on a month, training as a badge
options.thesis: Days away is a month calendar: away days shaded (half-shaded for a time of day), a repeating rule above it, tap a shaded day to make it an exception. Training is a small 'Training' badge on the name with a dotted tie to the trained person.
options.viewport: Three phones: the date sheet with a Training badge on Sam and an amber 'needs someone trained' line until Jo is on; the swap rule as three radio cards; November as a month with Sunday mornings half-shaded and 20 Dec crossed out as an exception.
options.risk: A month grid is a new shared component; a long run of days or 'until further notice' only shows a month at a time.

options.label: C: Trainee paired on the place, the rule as one choice
options.thesis: Trainee and trainer share one joined row ('Jo trains Sam'); alone, the trainee's row has an amber edge and 'Put someone trained on'. The swap rule is one stacked choice of three sentences. Days away is a single list; the editor asks Once or Every week first.
options.viewport: Three phones: the date sheet with Jo and Sam as one joined pair under Sound; the swap rule as the existing stacked Segmented with each option's detail line; the days-away sheet set to Every week, Sunday, Mornings, with two exception chips.
options.risk: A joined pair row is a new row shape; with two trainees and one trainer it needs care.
